description: This file defines a Smarty plugin modifier called 'capitalize' which capitalizes words in a string, with optional handling of digit characters.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_capitalize
methods.description: Capitalizes words in the input string, optionally handling digit characters, and applies a custom ucfirst function to each word.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_capitalize_ucfirst
methods.description: Returns an uppercase first letter of the given string, with special handling for digits and apostrophes based on internal static variable.
